channel.title: Tarun — Field Notes & Systems
channel.description: Documenting machine learning foundations, systems devlogs, and Japanese/Mandarin language acquisition.

item.title: The 365-Day Japanese Journey: Day 1 Kickoff
item.description: Setting up the daily 90-minute routine, phonetic kana muscle memory, and configuring Anki decks powered by stroke-order mnemonics.

item.title: Daily TIL: LoRA Rank Trade-offs & FlashAttention Intuitions
item.description: Why scaling rank r from 8 to 64 yields diminishing returns on stylistic alignment, but dramatic spikes in memory overhead.

item.title: Chinese Tones Contour Intuition: Singing Pitch Analogy
item.description: Treating the four tones as musical vocal warm-up intervals: First (high steady soprano), Second (questioning rise), Third (low dip), Fourth (sharp command).

item.title: Building PolyglotLens: From Idea to Working Vision-OCR Model
item.description: An end-to-end devlog detailing dataset distillation for historical vertical Japanese scripts and dense handwritten Chinese characters.

item.title: Architecting HanziFlow: Fast Local Radicals Storage with SQLite
item.description: Storing 214 Kangxi radicals, stroke decompositions, and audio waveforms offline in browser WASM threads.

item.title: Demystifying Small Language Models: What Actually Happens During Fine-Tuning
item.description: Peeling back the math of rank-decomposition matrices, low-rank adaptations, gradient flow across frozen weights, and testing local inferences with 1B-3B models.

item.title: Starting from Zero: Why I'm Learning Japanese and Mandarin Simultaneously
item.description: Exploring the cognitive synthesis of dual-orthography immersion, shared kanji/hanzi semantic anchors, and engineering a bidirectional spaced repetition engine.
